name: LAURON
def: Six legged walking robot modelled on the stick insect Carausius morosus, developed over several generations by the German research centre FZI Forschungszentrum Informatik.
facts: First version shown to the public at CeBIT in Hanover in 1994
First generation relied on an artificial neural network for control
Fifth generation, LAURON V, was completed in 2013
